server.name: community-codebase-memory
server.note: One of only two servers in the sample that annotate their mutating tools at all. index_repository declares idempotentHint:true and ingest_traces declares idempotentHint:false with destructiveHint:true, so both claims can be tested rather than assumed. The index lives in memory unless persistence is asked for, which is why the fixtures set it.

fixtures.note: declared idempotentHint:true, and the declaration is what is under test
